title: Expedition 33 Tier List - Best Characters Ranked
description: Expedition 33 character tier list ranking all 6 party members. Covers S-tier Maelle and Verso, A-tier Lune, Sciel, Gustave, and B-tier Monoco.

sections.title: Tier List Overview
sections.content:
This tier list ranks all six playable characters in Expedition 33 based on their overall contribution to the party, damage potential, versatility, and endgame viability. Rankings reflect community consensus from experienced players who have completed all content including the Endless Tower.

Important Context

  • All characters are viable. Expedition 33 is beatable with any party composition. This tier list reflects optimization, not necessity.
  • Tier placement depends on build: A well-built lower-tier character can outperform a poorly-built higher-tier one.
  • Party synergy matters more than individual tier: A B-tier character enabling an S-tier character's best turn is better than two A-tier characters competing for the same role.
  • Skill at Parrying matters: Characters that reward defensive mastery (Verso, Maelle) rank higher for players who can consistently Parry.

Tier Definitions

  • S Tier: Exceptional. Dominates content and enables the strongest strategies.
  • A Tier: Excellent. Strong in most situations with clear build paths.
  • B Tier: Good. Viable but less specialized or more situational than higher tiers.

sections.title: S Tier
sections.content:
Maelle — The Stance Master

StrengthDetails
Damage OutputHighest single-target damage in the game via Sword Ballet in Virtuose Stance. Also has top AoE through Phantom Strike.
VersatilityThree stances cover offense (Virtuose), defense (Defensive), and support (Guard Up for party Shell). Adapts to any situation.
Debuff SupportFencer's Flurry applies Defenseless (+25% damage from all sources) to ALL enemies on turn one. Benefits entire party for 3 turns.
Self-SufficiencyWith Jarum/Lithum weapons, Parrying auto-enters Virtuose Stance. Stance switching generates AP. Barely needs external support.
SynergyWorks with every team. Burn combo with Lune, Mark combo with Verso/Gustave, Solo with Last Stand Pictos.

Why S-Tier: Maelle has the highest damage ceiling, the best opening-turn debuff, strong support options, and functions in literally any team composition. She's the only character who excels at BOTH single-target and AoE damage while also providing party utility.

Verso — The Perfection Fighter

StrengthDetails
Damage ScalingS-Rank unlocks extraordinary damage multipliers. Multi-hit skills hit incredibly hard at max Rank.
FlexibilityThree completely different weapon builds (Gaulteram DPS, Dualiso double-turn, Sireso support) let him fill any role.
Team SupportPowerful (party damage buff), Marking Shot (setup for allies), Sireso (Rank buffs all allies). Can be the best enabler OR the best DPS.
Skill CeilingRewards mastery — players who never take damage maintain S-Rank permanently for devastating sustained output.

Why S-Tier: Verso combines the highest skill ceiling with unmatched build flexibility. Whether as a self-sufficient DPS or a team amplifier, he provides more value than any other character when played optimally. His weakness (losing Rank when hit) is mitigated by player skill.

sections.title: A Tier
sections.content:
Lune — The Elemental Healer

StrengthDetails
HealingBest healer in the game. Essential for keeping aggressive DPS characters alive through difficult encounters.
Elemental DamageStain system provides excellent elemental coverage. Endgame weapons (Esquim, Cleim) unlock massive damage potential.
Burn SetupImmolation enables Maelle's strongest combos. Critical Burn Lumina makes Burn ticks a major damage source.
Weapon VarietyFour excellent weapon options (Trebuchim, Snowim, Esquim, Cleim) for different stages of the game.

Why A-Tier: Lune is the backbone of most teams. Her healing keeps everyone alive, her Burn setup enables Maelle, and her own late-game damage becomes formidable. She's not S-Tier because she's more of an enabler than a damage powerhouse until endgame weapons.

Sciel — The Twilight Nuker

StrengthDetails
AoE DamageTwilight state deals devastating area damage to multiple enemies simultaneously.
Foretell StackingEnemies take escalating damage with each Foretell stack. Extremely strong in longer fights.
Charnon Synergy100% Crit in Twilight + Sealed Fate = Foretell never decays during damage window. Exponential scaling.

Why A-Tier: Sciel excels at AoE situations and becomes incredibly powerful in Twilight. She needs ramp time and healing support (pairs best with Lune), which limits her versatility compared to S-Tier characters. Pure DPS without utility.

Gustave — The Reliable Lead

StrengthDetails
ConsistencyOvercharge provides reliable burst damage without the risk of losing rank (like Verso) or needing stance setup (like Maelle).
Mark ApplicationMarking Shot sets up massive damage for any party member — universal utility.
Shield BreakingLumiere Assault (5 hits) is one of the best shield-removal tools in the game.
Early AvailabilityAvailable from the start. Your most leveled and upgraded character for most of the game.

Why A-Tier: Gustave is reliable, available early, and provides solid damage plus Mark utility. He lacks the explosive ceiling of Maelle/Verso and the unique support of Lune, but he's never a bad choice and requires the least specific setup to perform well.

sections.title: B Tier
sections.content:
Monoco — The Flexible Gestral

StrengthDetails
AP GenerationPotier Energy + Ballaro weapon = massive AP generation for entire party. Excellent enabler.
Transformation VarietyBestial Wheel grants access to many enemy forms, providing extreme elemental coverage.
AdaptabilityCan fill any role the team needs — DPS, support, elemental coverage, AP generation.
WeaknessDetails
Late AvailabilityJoins in late Act 2, giving less time to level up and unlock forms.
Form DependencyDPS power scales with which bosses you've defeated. Earlier in the game, forms are weaker.
Jack-of-All-TradesCan do everything but specializes in nothing. Other characters outperform him in dedicated roles.

Why B-Tier: Monoco is the most flexible character but the least specialized. His AP support (Ballaro + Potier Energy) is genuinely excellent, but characters like Verso (Sireso) can provide similar team amplification while also dealing damage. His Bestial Wheel transformations scale with game progress, making him strongest in the very endgame when other characters are already fully built. He's never bad — just rarely the best choice for a specific role.

sections.title: Tier Explanations & Team Recommendations
sections.content:
What Makes S-Tier Characters Special?

Maelle and Verso share one trait that separates them from the rest: they dominate in their primary role while ALSO providing significant team utility. Maelle deals the most damage AND debuffs all enemies. Verso deals top-tier damage OR amplifies the entire team. Other characters excel at one thing but not both.

Recommended Team Compositions

Best Overall Team: Maelle + Verso (Sireso) + Lune

  • Maelle: Primary DPS with Fencer's Flurry debuff and Sword Ballet nukes
  • Verso: Sireso support amplifying Maelle's damage, applying Marks and Powerful buff
  • Lune: Healing, Burn setup for Maelle, elemental coverage

Best AoE Team: Sciel + Maelle + Lune

  • Sciel: Twilight AoE devastation with Charnon weapon
  • Maelle: Phantom Strike AoE + Fencer's Flurry debuff to amplify Sciel
  • Lune: Healing to keep Sciel alive during Twilight ramp

Best Boss Kill Team: Verso (Dualiso) + Maelle + Gustave

  • Verso: Double-turn burst with Phantom Stars at S-Rank
  • Maelle: Sword Ballet + Defenseless debuff
  • Gustave: Marking Shot setup + Overcharge burst

Best Beginner Team: Gustave + Lune + Maelle

  • Available early with strong synergies (Lune Burn → Maelle combo)
  • Gustave is reliable and forgiving; Lune heals mistakes; Maelle provides damage
  • Recommended for first playthrough before Verso and Sciel are available
